# Abstract {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This dynamic and reproducible tutorial is part of a broader research initiative on utilizing Generalized Estimating Equation (GEE) in crossover studies within the context of randomized clinical trials related to physiotherapy and rehabilitation [@georgeto2024a; @georgeto2024b; @rogers2024d]. The primary goal is to provide a comprehensive application tutorial in the R environment, demonstrating best practices for analyzing crossover designs using GEE.

This project adopts open science principles and reproducible research practices as outlined by @limongi2025a, @limongi2025b, and @rogers2025, ensuring transparency, accessibility, and replicability of all analyses and results. The tutorial integrates theoretical foundations with practical implementation, offering researchers and practitioners a hands-on guide for conducting rigorous statistical analyses in crossover clinical trials.

**Keywords:** Quantitative Methods, Generalized Estimating Equation, GEE, Crossover Trials, Crossover Studies, Reproducible Research, Open Science.

**How to cite this project?**

Rogers, P., & Georgeto, S. M. (2024). Utilizing GEE in Crossover Studies. <https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/MU67G>
